notes: Printed: 'When this creature enters, if it entered from your graveyard or you cast it from your graveyard, exile it. If you do, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.' No compiled card lets a player cast it from a graveyard, so a test permission does (test_permission_cast, the effect-cast lane a real permission takes). Seat 0 casts the Vessel from its graveyard in its main phase, paying {B}; the CAST row records the graveyard (kick_rows 'from'). It resolves and enters from the stack, not the graveyard, so only the second half of the condition holds: you cast it from your graveyard. The Vessel is exiled and a 5/5 flying Demon is created. A Vessel put onto the battlefield from the graveyard would exile itself too, by the first half; the CAST row is what tells this cast from that.
